title: CS Disco, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: CS Disco, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 22, 2026 disclosing director changes: Toby Williams was appointed to the board as a Class II director, while two existing directors (Colette Pierce Burnette and Aaron Clark) will not stand for reelection at the 2026 annual meeting. The board will be reduced from ten to eight directors following their departure.
key_points: Toby Williams appointed to CS Disco board as Class II director effective April 22, 2026
Williams serves as President and CEO of Paylocity Holding Corporation since August 2024
Board size to be reduced from ten to eight directors after 2026 annual meeting
Williams eligible for $300,000 initial RSU award vesting in 12 quarterly installments
Williams eligible for $150,000 annual RSU award and $35,000 annual cash retainer
Two directors (Burnette and Clark) not standing for reelection at 2026 annual meeting
